useWhen: Normalize a Linear export an operator already holds, convert it between CSV and GraphQL JSON, or check cycle progress, estimates and SLA risk with dandori rules
avoidWhen: Reading from or writing to a live Linear workspace, or assuming the results match Linear's own calculations

inputs.text: Linear CSV or GraphQL JSON export (<= 5 MiB)

outputs.issues: Linear GraphQL-shaped issue nodes and teams
outputs.decisions: cycle progress permille, estimate validity, SLA status

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry and owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 709c948, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__dandori__<tool> and does not start MCP subprocesses on peer runs. Data-format compatibility only; no connection to linear.app.
requires: cloud-itonami/app-itonami-dandori checkout at the pinned commit

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve the absolute checkout before writing the client config. The launcher finds nbb.edn from its own path and resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text git dependency into ~/.gitlibs; no cwd is required.
